title: MEIKO — That Same Excitement〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm all done cleaning, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know it's a little early, but why don't we have lunch? I'll make us some sandwiches.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Today's been so calm.
I wonder if Kohane and the others are traveling somewhere to perform.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I know how busy they've been lately, but it would be nice to see them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: E-E-E-Everyone! You need to hear this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa, you scared me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Luka...
Please be more gentle when opening the door.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry! But it's an emergency!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An emergency?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes! A square or a plaza or something...!
Whatever it is, a new area just appeared in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A new area...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's just trying to pull one over on us again...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Remember what you said the other day?
You ran around telling us all about how Crase Cafe had a secret menu with ramen on it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We won't be fooled again!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
N-No, listen!
I'm telling you the truth this time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Maybe she is. This doesn't feel like one of her usual fibs...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know how you feel, Len, but I did make you some ramen that time, remember? Why don't we just let that one slide?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, let's go see what she's talking about. I mean, it isn't like her to run around shouting about an “emergency”.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
True. And if she is telling the truth...
Len, Rin, we need to go see this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? Well, if you two are willing to believe her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, Luka, mind showing us the way?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay! Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Wh-What is this place...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka was right. I've never seen this plaza before.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me neither...
Have you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, this is also my first time seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
S-So, you weren't kidding...?
A completely new area just appeared out of thin air?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Didn't I say that?!
I sprinted over to the cafe to tell you all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How do you think I felt when you said that I was lying...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... S-Sorry about that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I sure hope so!
Why didn't you believe me?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because of your track record.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, why'd this place decide to appear all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The others' feelings must've made a new area form in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we'll need to do some exploring in order to find out what feelings went into this place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, we're gonna go exploring?!
That means we should let Akito and the others know!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll go tell them now!!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem awfully calm about this, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right back at you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You keeping your cool is the reason I don't feel all that bothered by this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm flattered, Miku.
Well, nothing good ever comes from panicking...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we all wait here in the plaza while we wait for the others to arrive? I'd rather not see anyone get lost before they do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But! I wanna go exploring!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, Len isn't here, so let's wait patiently for them to all get here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, fine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Still... There's something strange about this place.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm seeing graffiti everywhere, and each alleyway feels completely different from one another...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (What feelings can cause all this?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. I know I just told Rin to be patient, but I can't wait to start exploring...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Something's changed in the others, and I want to find out what.)
